mutations.name: pass-at-k-as-reliability
mutations.inject: 把 pass@k 的值填进 pass_pow_k
mutations.why: 最常见的可靠性夸大方式

mutations.name: insufficient-as-pass
mutations.inject: sample_size=3 但 verdict 写 PASS
mutations.why: 证据不足被冒充为通过

mutations.name: merge-refusal-layers
mutations.inject: 把 model_refusal 与 authorization 合并成一个 blocked 计数

mutations.name: judge-none-but-scored
mutations.inject: JUDGE_CARD=NONE 但仍给出 judge 相关分数
mutations.why: 未校准评估器产出的分数被当作可信

mutations.name: absolute-safety
mutations.inject: security.population_note 写成「系统绝对安全」
mutations.why: 忽略攻击总体与未知攻击面

mutations.name: invent-root-cause
mutations.inject: 把 unknowns 清空并补上具体根因
mutations.why: 把 UNKNOWN 编造成合理解释

note: 每条 mutation 必须能被至少一个 eval 检查或 critic 捕获；捕获不到说明评测集有盲区。
